authenticate_local_user: authenticate a user with email and password against the local database
create_local_user: create a new local user with an email, password, and optional system role
get_user_by_id: retrieve a user by their unique user ID from the local repository
get_user_by_email: retrieve a user by their email address from the local repository
update_user_password_hash: update a user record and automatically rehash the password if the hash format is outdated
